draw_pile.note: 71 remaining tiles (1 start tile pre-placed); only server knows order

play_area.note: grows as tiles are placed; starts with one tile at origin

scoring_track.note: score wraps; points beyond 50 continue around the track

landscape_tile.note: each tile has 4 edges typed as city/road/field; 24 distinct tile configurations in base game

meeple.note: placed on features (city, road, monastery, field) of a just-placed tile

phases.name: draw_tile
phases.action: reveal drawn tile to all players

phases.name: place_tile
phases.note: tile must be placed adjacent to an existing tile with all edges matching neighbors

phases.name: place_meeple
phases.trigger: after place_tile, if player has meeple in supply
phases.note: meeple goes on one feature (city, road, monastery, or field) of the tile just placed; feature must not already have a meeple on any connected segment

phases.name: score_completed
phases.note: server checks if tile placement completed any cities, roads, or monasteries; scores and returns meeples

constraints: cell must be orthogonally adjacent to at least one placed tile
all edges touching adjacent tiles must match terrain type (city-city, road-road, field-field)
tile_placement.note: edge matching is validated by WASM module

constraints: player must have at least one meeple in supply
meeple is placed on the tile just placed this turn
chosen feature (city, road, monastery, field) must not already be occupied by any meeple on connected segments
meeple_placement.note: connected feature occupancy check requires WASM flood-fill

city_scoring.effect: 2 points per tile in city + 2 per pennant; return meeples to owners
city_scoring.note: incomplete cities score 1 per tile + 1 per pennant at game end

road_scoring.trigger: road feature connects two endpoints (intersection, city, or dead end)
road_scoring.effect: 1 point per tile in road; return meeples to owners
road_scoring.note: incomplete roads score 1 per tile at game end

monastery_scoring.trigger: monastery tile is completely surrounded (8 adjacent tiles placed)
monastery_scoring.effect: 9 points (1 for monastery + 8 surrounding); return meeple to owner
monastery_scoring.note: incomplete monasteries score 1 + number of surrounding tiles at game end

field_scoring.effect: 3 points per completed city adjacent to the field
field_scoring.note: fields never return meeples; field adjacency to cities requires WASM analysis

majority_rule.definition: when a feature has multiple meeples (via merging), the player(s) with the most meeples score
majority_rule.effect: tied players all receive full points

tile_rotation.definition: tiles may be rotated 0, 90, 180, or 270 degrees before placement

end_conditions.condition: draw_pile is empty AND final scoring complete
end_conditions.name: all_tiles_placed
